published_records_investigated.title: KAAD Scholarship
findings: Official KAAD Programme 1 is restricted to qualified applicants from partner/focus countries in Africa, Asia, Middle East and Latin America.
German B1 (A2 for English-taught degrees) is specified; no universal IELTS/TOEFL/SAT numeric score.
The official programme states awards become loans if study/research is not directed toward reintegration in home region.
The record’s EUR 861/month plus tuition claim was not established on the programme page.

proposed_fields.funding_type: conditional scholarship; may become loan under stated reintegration condition

published_records_investigated.duplicate_risk: KAAD Eastern Europe and KAAD Programme 2 are distinct.

published_records_investigated.title: Hamad Bin Khalifa University Engineering Masters Award
findings: HBKU offers funding contingent on admission, merit/need, availability and research/teaching assistant commitments; not guaranteed.
International Master stipend guideline QAR 7,000/month; international PhD QAR 9,000/month for selected funded students.
Graduate 2027 international admission deadline February 1; Qatari/resident applicants seeking funding March 15. These are admissions deadlines, not separately published scholarship deadlines.
HBKU explicitly states students pay their own housing; generic full tuition + stipend + housing claims are false.
Master tuition waiver varies by degree: STEM 75%, SHAPE 60%, certain programmes 0%; PhD generally 100% for selected awards.

proposed_fields.deadline_notes: International graduate admission 2027-02-01; Qatari/resident funding-related admission 2027-03-15; no separate scholarship application
proposed_fields.tuition_coverage: programme-dependent and conditional; never universal full tuition plus housing
proposed_fields.stipend: selected international MS QAR 7,000/month; selected international PhD QAR 9,000/month, conditional on RA/TA and funds

published_records_investigated.duplicate_risk: Six generic records appear to represent overlapping HBKU graduate scholarship policy; reconcile identity before edits or archiving.

published_records_investigated.title: Minerva University Scholarship
findings: Minerva explicitly states no full-ride financial aid packages.
Need-based packages may combine nonrepayable scholarships, low-interest student loans, and work-study; these must not all be classified as scholarship grants.
Financial aid application must occur during the admissions cycle, before decision; no universal award amount or date on the programme page.

proposed_fields.funding_type: need-based scholarship component only, not loan/work-study
proposed_fields.tuition_coverage: variable need-based award, not guaranteed full tuition

published_records_investigated.title: Strathmore University Scholarship
findings: Strathmore official aid office lists distinct SU merit/need, sports, bursaries, work-study and LOAN categories.
Not every student gets full tuition; university intake deadline guidance is by course/intake, not one universal date.
The published generic record requires identity reconciliation with named merit/need award and an existing EAC Scholarship draft.

proposed_fields.funding_type: varies by named grant; loans excluded
proposed_fields.tuition_coverage: partial or full only for selected eligible awards

published_records_investigated.duplicate_risk: Existing private EAC Scholarship Programme Cohort 4 is separate; do not duplicate.

published_records_investigated.title: Zayed University Scholarship
findings: Current published record conflates UAE national government-funded tuition with limited merit scholarships for international students.

An official English scholarship page describes President 100%, Academic Merit 50%/25% and SAT Math thresholds 650/590; a separate official Arabic page says up to 50% with IELTS 6.0 (minimum section 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 80.
These official pages conflict; do not apply any one tier/test threshold universally without university confirmation.
Staging already contains archived and private draft records titled Zayed University Undergraduate Merit Scholarship.

proposed_fields.funding_type: institution-specific limited merit scholarships; do not equate with universal full tuition
proposed_fields.eligible_nationalities: international self-funding undergraduates for merit awards; national funding separate

published_records_investigated.duplicate_risk: Exact-name archived and private draft Zayed merit records already exist; resolve before publication.
